title: phegopteris aspleniifolia
intro: Phegopteris aspleniifolia, commonly known as the Asplenium fern, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Aspleniaceae family. The health benefits of Phegopteris aspleniifolia include its ability to treat fever, inflammation, and rheumatism, as well as its use as a diuretic to aid in urinary issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties, which help to reduce pain and inflammation, and lower fever. The bioactive constituents of Phegopteris aspleniifolia include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
